about: After Effects popup (dropdown) labels for the harvested effects, index -> label (1-based, as the scripting API and PVE specs count them). Labels are the English UI strings the installed plug-ins carry; each popup records where its list came from and how it was matched to the property.

method.source: where the readback answered (basis 'API readback' or confirmed_by): the menu After Effects itself lists; else string resources inside each plug-in binary (Adobe ZStrings '$$$/AE/<plugin>/LStr/<n>=a|b|c', third-party plain C strings), PresetEffects.xml for pseudo effects, BEE.dll for the text animator / selector menus and FLT.dll for Compositing Options
method.matching: a candidate is a 1d property with min 1 and a whole max N (the harvest). A numbered ZString table lists the menus in parameter order, so its '|'-lists are aligned with the candidates on equal item counts, order preserved (basis 'table order + count'; unique = the alignment allows no other list); plain strings come in no useful order, so a list is taken only when it is the plug-in's one list of that size or the one beside the property's name; core tables by name + count (the list next to the name string)
method.readback: After Effects 26.0 scripting, every candidate on a solid: Property.propertyParameters (the menu's items; it throws 'does not have dropdown menu options' on a slider), then 1..N set and read back with Property.valueText (the current item's text), 1.5 (a popup snaps it) and isInterpolationTypeValid(LINEAR) (false = Hold-only keyframes). Where the API lists a menu, its items are the labels; the string-table list either matches (confirmed_by) or is kept as string_table_labels. Effects that open a file dialog (DIALOG_EFFECTS) are not probed
method.separators: '(-' is a menu separator: it occupies an index (counted in N) but cannot be picked in the UI
method.cards: uses = how often the match name appears in shipped presets (1 each) and recipe stacks (3 each); hedged_card = the effect's card hedges on its labels or index order (read-only check, cards not edited)
